# LibreOffice Calc GUI Interface Description

## Window and Application Header
- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "TaxReturn.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc"
- **System Information Bar**: Shows "Oct 22 19:21" and a notification bell icon
- **Window Control Buttons**: Minimize, Maximize, and Close buttons on the top-right corner
- **Desktop Environment Indicator**: "Activities" on the top-left corner

## Application Menu Bar
- **Menu Options**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, Help

## Toolbar
- **Standard Toolbar Icons**: Includes file operations (New, Open, Save, Print), clipboard operations (Cut, Copy, Paste), formatting tools (Bold, Italic, Underline, Font Color, Background Color), alignment tools, and more.
- **Font and Size Selection**: Font dropdown set to "Calibri", font size dropdown set to "11 pt"
- **Formula Bar**: Displays cell reference "B4" and formula/number "1200000"

## Notification Banner
- **Blue Banner**: Contains two informational messages:
  - "Help us make LibreOffice even better!"
  - "Your donations support our worldwide community."
- **Action Buttons**: "Get involved" and "Donate" buttons on the right side of the banner

## Worksheet Area
- **Grid Layout**: Standard spreadsheet grid with columns labeled A through R and rows numbered 1 through 36
- **Active Cell**: Cell B4 is selected, highlighted with a red border
- **Worksheet Title**: "Corporate Tax Return - 2024" centered in row 3, spanning columns A to R
- **Content Structure**:
  - **Revenues Section** (Rows 4-8):
    - Row 4: "Product Sales" with value "$1,200,000" in cell B4
    - Row 5: "Service Revenue" with value "$450,000" in cell B5
    - Row 6: "Investment Income" with value "$50,000" in cell B6
    - Row 7: "Other Income" with value "$15,000" in cell B7
    - Row 8: "Total Revenue" with value "$1,715,000" in cell B8
  - **Expenses Section** (Rows 10-20):
    - Row 10: "Expenses" as a header
    - Row 11: "COGS" with value "$600,000" in cell B11
    - Row 12: "Salaries" with value "$400,000" in cell B12
    - Row 13: "Rent" with value "$120,000" in cell B13
    - Row 14: "Marketing" with value "$80,000" in cell B14
    - Row 15: "R&D" with value "$150,000" in cell B15
    - Row 16: "Depreciation" with value "$50,000" in cell B16
    - Row 17: "Travel" with value "$20,000" in cell B17
    - Row 18: "Utilities" with value "$30,000" in cell B18
    - Row 19: "Other Expenses" with value "$15,000" in cell B19
    - Row 20: "Total Expenses" with value "$1,465,000" in cell B20
  - **Tax Calculation Section** (Rows 22-24):
    - Row 22: "Taxable Income" with value "250000" in cell B22
    - Row 23: "Tax Rate" with value "21.00%" in cell B23
    - Row 24: "Tax Liability" with value "52500" in cell B24

## Sidebar and Vertical Scroll Bar
- **Vertical Scroll Bar**: Located on the right side of the worksheet area
- **Sidebar Icons**: Contains icons for various LibreOffice applications (Writer, Calc, Impress, Draw, Base, Math, and others) on the left side of the screen

## Status Bar
- **Sheet Information**: "Sheet 1 of 1" and "TaxReturn" tab
- **Page Style**: "PageStyle_TaxReturn"
- **Language Setting**: "English (Hong Kong)"
- **Statistics**: "Average: $1
